stories.title: BIS paper finds major gap in Bitcoin on-chain transfer estimates
stories.summary: A paper from the Bank for International Settlements says common methods for estimating Bitcoin's on-chain transfer volumes contain a significant gap, meaning widely cited activity figures may be less reliable than assumed. The report questions how analysts read economic activity directly off the blockchain.
stories.whyItMatters: On-chain volume figures feed into valuation models and policy debates, so a flagged measurement gap could undercut arguments built on those numbers.
whatToWatch: Whether other researchers or data providers respond to or revise their methodologies
Any follow-up commentary from BIS on policy implications
questions: How large is the estimated gap, and which metrics does it distort most?
Does this change how regulators or index providers report Bitcoin activity data?

sources.title: BIS paper finds major gap in Bitcoin onchain transfer estimates

stories.title: Week-long aelf outage wipes out staking rewards after emergency shutdown
stories.summary: The aelf blockchain suffered a seven-day outage following an emergency shutdown, and the disruption erased a full week of staking rewards for holders. Details on the root cause of the shutdown are limited.
stories.whyItMatters: Extended outages that cost stakers real yield raise reliability questions for smaller layer-1 networks competing for capital and trust.
whatToWatch: Any official post-mortem or root-cause disclosure from the aelf team
Whether affected stakers are compensated
questions: What triggered the emergency shutdown in the first place?
Will validators or token holders see any restitution for lost rewards?

sources.title: 7-day blockchain outage wipes out a full week of staking rewards after emergency aelf shutdown

stories.title: CoinEx to shut down after 9 years, citing shrinking crypto trading activity
stories.summary: Exchange CoinEx said it will cease operations after nine years, pointing to a "significant" contraction in crypto trading. Coverage frames the closure as part of a broader trend of trading volume concentrating at the largest exchanges.
stories.whyItMatters: A mid-sized exchange exiting the market signals consolidation pressure that could reduce competition and choice for traders.
whatToWatch: Timeline and process for user fund withdrawals before shutdown
Whether other mid-tier exchanges follow with similar announcements
questions: Were there any operational, legal, or solvency issues beyond stated market contraction?
How will CoinEx handle remaining customer assets during wind-down?

stories.title: Standard Chartered says Arbitrum could outperform Bitcoin, Ether through 2030
stories.summary: Standard Chartered analysts reportedly project that Arbitrum could outperform both Bitcoin and Ether through 2030. As with any long-dated price forecast, this is an analyst opinion rather than a settled outcome.
stories.whyItMatters: Bank-branded long-term price calls can move sentiment and retail flows even when the underlying reasoning and assumptions aren't disclosed.
whatToWatch: Whether Standard Chartered publishes the underlying model or price targets
Any market or Arbitrum price reaction to the call
questions: What assumptions and timeframe milestones underlie this specific forecast?
Does Standard Chartered have any disclosed position or business relationship with Arbitrum?

stories.title: Crypto stocks slide after CLARITY Act fails to advance in Senate
stories.summary: Crypto-linked stocks fell after the US Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act, a bill meant to set clearer digital-asset market rules. The setback removes, for now, a piece of regulatory certainty markets had been pricing in.
stories.whyItMatters: Market-structure legislation directly affects how exchanges, issuers, and token projects can legally operate in the US, so delays extend the current regulatory ambiguity.
whatToWatch: Whether Senate leadership schedules another vote or revised version of the bill
Continued stock price moves in crypto-exposed equities
questions: What specifically blocked the vote from advancing?
Is a revised bill likely before the end of the current session?

US Senate fails to advance CLARITY Act

stories.title: Is DeFi's reported $20 billion surge real growth or just token price inflation?
stories.summary: An analysis questions whether a widely cited $20 billion jump in DeFi metrics reflects genuine new activity or is largely an artifact of rising token prices inflating dollar-denominated totals. The piece pushes back on headline TVL-style figures.
stories.whyItMatters: Total-value-locked and similar metrics are commonly used to gauge DeFi's health, so distinguishing real growth from price effects matters for anyone assessing the sector.
whatToWatch: Whether TVL trackers or protocols publish price-adjusted growth figures
Any follow-up analysis confirming or disputing the inflation claim
questions: What portion of the reported surge is attributable to price versus new deposits?
Which specific protocols or chains account for most of the disputed gains?

sources.title: Did crypto’s $20 Billion DeFi surge just get stolen by price inflation?

stories.title: Binance adds 11 US-listed ETFs to its wealth management offering
stories.summary: Binance has added 11 US-listed exchange-traded funds to its wealth management product lineup, expanding beyond crypto-native assets. No further detail on which specific funds were included was provided.
stories.whyItMatters: A major exchange broadening into traditional ETFs shows continued blending of crypto platforms with mainstream investment products.
whatToWatch: Which specific ETFs are included and whether the list expands over time
Regulatory reaction in jurisdictions where Binance offers this service
questions: Which markets and customer segments can access this offering?
Does this require any new regulatory approval where Binance operates?

stories.title: US House crypto tax package leaves out mining and staking reward deferral
stories.summary: A crypto tax package moving through the US House reportedly does not include provisions that would have deferred taxation on mining and staking rewards. That omission keeps current tax treatment of those rewards in place for now.
stories.whyItMatters: Tax treatment of mining and staking rewards affects the economics of running validators and miners in the US, and the industry has long pushed for deferral.
whatToWatch: Whether the provision is added back through amendment before a floor vote
Industry response and lobbying efforts following the omission
questions: Why were mining and staking deferral provisions excluded from this version?
Could deferral language still be added in the Senate or in reconciliation?

sources.title: US House crypto tax package omits mining, staking reward deferral

stories.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows return, but BlackRock is doing most of the heavy lifting
stories.summary: Bitcoin ETF inflows have turned positive again, but the rebound is reportedly concentrated in BlackRock's fund rather than spread across issuers. The renewed flows come as markets head into an upcoming Federal Reserve meeting.
stories.whyItMatters: Inflow concentration in a single issuer suggests the broader ETF market's demand recovery may be narrower and more fragile than headline totals imply.
whatToWatch: Upcoming Federal Reserve meeting and its effect on risk appetite
Whether inflows broaden to other Bitcoin ETF issuers
questions: Why is demand concentrating so heavily in BlackRock's fund specifically?
How sensitive are these flows to the Fed's coming rate decision?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows are back, but BlackRock is carrying the market into the Fed meeting

stories.title: Ethics dispute tied to Trump helps sink CLARITY Act in Senate vote
stories.summary: The CLARITY Act failed in a Senate vote amid a dispute over ethics concerns connected to Trump, according to reporting on the defeat. The ethics fight is described as a significant factor in the bill's collapse.
stories.whyItMatters: If a political dispute unrelated to market-structure policy is deciding the fate of crypto legislation, that adds an unpredictable variable to when clearer rules might arrive.
whatToWatch: Whether the ethics dispute is resolved or continues to block future votes
Any revised bill introduced without the disputed elements
questions: What specifically is the ethics concern, and who raised it?
Can the bill be decoupled from this dispute in a future attempt?

sources.title: Trump ethics fight sinks CLARITY Act in dramatic Senate defeat

stories.title: USDT payments reportedly featured in Polish energy giant's failed $230M oil deal
stories.summary: According to a Financial Times report cited by Cointelegraph, USDT stablecoin payments were involved in a failed $230 million oil deal tied to a Polish energy company. Details of why the deal fell through are limited in what's been reported.
stories.whyItMatters: Stablecoin use surfacing in a large, failed commodity deal highlights how crypto rails are creeping into traditional trade finance, along with the risks when such deals go wrong.
whatToWatch: Further FT or company disclosures on why the deal collapsed
Any regulatory or legal scrutiny of the USDT payment component
questions: What role did USDT actually play in the deal's failure?
Are other parties or counterparties involved facing exposure or investigation?

stories.title: Senator Lummis says it's 'now or never' for the CLARITY Act
stories.summary: Senator Cynthia Lummis, known as a pro-Bitcoin voice in Congress, said it is "now or never" for the CLARITY Act, underscoring urgency around the crypto market-structure bill's prospects. The comment reflects growing pressure around the legislation's fate.
stories.whyItMatters: Lummis has been a key Senate advocate for crypto policy, so her framing signals how much political capital and time remain for this bill in the current session.
whatToWatch: Whether the Senate schedules another attempt at passing the bill
Lummis's next legislative moves if this version stalls
questions: What happens to crypto market-structure policy if this specific push fails?
Is Lummis proposing any changes to revive the bill's chances?
